original_finding: Working manifest was parsed without comparing it to the declared commit. Accidental deletion of artifact entries, including an empty set, could skip report members and still yield PASS.
rule: AGENTS durable delivery must match original manifest and committed blobs; exact declared set may not be weakened by working metadata.
closure: Manifest raw bytes first match the declared committed blob, then parsing rejects empty or non-dictionary artifact sets before iterating.
execution: Neither old nor corrected verifier was run by this reviewer.
outer_checkout_boundary: This verifier does not create/remove checkouts. Root must separately use no-checkout before sparse setup, materialize only declared small files and remove normally; no full source/dependency/evidence restoration is authorized.
